newsitem.title: BURMA: Burma to buy $50 mln rail equipment from China.
newsitem.headline: Burma to buy $50 mln rail equipment from China.

text.p: Burma's Rail Transportation Ministry signed a deal to buy $50 million worth of railway equipment from China's Yunnan Machinery and Equipment Import and Export Corp (YMEC), Myanmar News Agency reported on Wednesday.
The state-run news agency said Myanma Railways would buy rails, locomotives, coaches and rolling stock from YMEC with a $50 million loan provided by the corporation.

Over the past few years, railroads have expanded rapidly across Burma. A total of 612.4 miles of new railroads have been constructed since the military seized power in 1988, official statistics show. Burma now has about 2,600 miles of railroads.
